name: LiteRT (TFLite successor)
notable_features: LiteRT is the successor to TensorFlow Lite, announced 2025
Maintains .tflite model format - existing TFLite models are compatible
Supports Android (NNAPI, GPU delegate, Hexagon), iOS (CoreML, Metal), and embedded Linux
Smaller binary footprint than TFLite - stripped unused ops and delegates
Part of the TensorFlow ecosystem - seamless transition from TF training to mobile deployment
hardware_caveats: .tflite format is TensorFlow-specific - no GGUF, ONNX, or safetensors support without conversion
LLM support is limited - TensorFlow Lite is primarily for vision and small models
No continuous batching or paged KV cache - single-stream inference only
GPU delegate performance varies significantly by device and driver
Smaller LLM ecosystem than llama.cpp or MLX
best_for: TensorFlow users who want to deploy models on-device without leaving the TF ecosystem
Android apps using NNAPI or GPU delegate for hardware acceleration
iOS apps using CoreML for Neural Engine acceleration
Vision and small models on mobile - TFLite's traditional strength
avoid_for: Large language models - TFLite/LiteRT is not optimized for LLM inference
Non-TensorFlow models - conversion to TensorFlow is required
Maximum performance on Apple Silicon - MLX is faster on Metal
High-concurrency serving - no batching or scheduling support
notes: LiteRT is the rebranded TensorFlow Lite, announced 2025. It maintains compatibility with existing .tflite models while reducing binary footprint. For local LLM inference, LiteRT is not the primary choice - it is optimized for vision and small models. However, it is the right choice for TensorFlow-centric workflows and for models that fit within its optimization envelope. For LLM-specific work, llama.cpp, MLX, or ONNX Runtime Mobile are better choices. ||| MAINTENANCE (dated fact, GitHub API, 2026-10-04): last commit 2026-10-04 (0.0 months before this record), latest release v2.21.0 published 2026-03-06, 5353 contributors (distinct committers including anonymous), open_issues_count 3275 (issues PLUS pull requests - see [[ev-github-open-issues-count-includes-pull-requests]]), not archived, 200700 stars.
